intro: A PM intern resume gets **~20 seconds**. It has to show **product thinking without product experience**. Here's what that looks like.

bulletFormula.bad: Worked on a team project to build a study app.
bulletFormula.good: Led a **4-person team** to ship a study app to **200 students in 6 weeks**; cut sign-up drop-off from **60% to 25%** after **5 user interviews**.

sections.name: Experience & projects
keep: Show the PM parts: **research, prioritisation, a trade-off you made, a metric you moved**

sections.name: Skills
keep: **SQL**, one analytics tool, Figma if real
No skill bars, no "proficient in MS Word"

sections.name: Education
keep: One line of relevant coursework, max

mistakes: **Responsibilities instead of results** — "was responsible for X" says nothing happened.
**No numbers anywhere.** Even a small one ("12 interviews", "3 features cut") beats none.
Listing every hackathon. **Two strong projects beat six weak ones.**
A wall of text. **One page**, generous margins, one font.
**Buzzwords with no substance** — "synergy", "passionate about disruption", "10x mindset".
Tailoring nothing. **Mirror the language in the JD** for the specific company.
checklist: The PM skills are visible: **research, prioritisation, metrics, a trade-off**
**No typos** — read it backwards, word by word
A friend can tell **what you actually did** in each role in 5 seconds

sample.note: A made-up final-year student. Copy the shape, never the numbers. Every note on the right is a reason a line is there.

header.name: Asha Rao
header.note: Name, one line, links. No photo, no address, no "objective".

bullets.text: Interviewed **12 students** before writing code. **9 of 12** sold items in WhatsApp groups and lost track of buyers.
bullets.note: Research first. A count of interviews shows you started from the problem.

bullets.text: Cut the first release to **3 features** (listing, chat, pickup slot) from a list of **11**, using an impact/effort grid.
bullets.note: A trade-off you made. The most PM-like line on the page.

bullets.text: Shipped to **200 students in 6 weeks**; **38%** listed a second item within a week.
bullets.note: Outcome, scale and time frame. A small user base still counts if you measured it.

bullets.text: Cut sign-up drop-off from **60% to 25%** by moving the OTP step after first browse.
bullets.note: A metric you moved, and the one change that moved it.

bullets.text: Built a feedback form used by **340 residents**; findings on food waste led to menu changes in **2 of 4** hostels.
bullets.note: Impact beyond the code: someone changed something because of your work.

bullets.text: Wrote SQL that showed **70%** of complaints came from one meal slot.
bullets.note: Analytical skill in one line, with the finding attached.

bullets.text: Built a weekly delays dashboard for **3 ops managers**, replacing a spreadsheet that took **2 hours** every Monday.
bullets.note: Time saved and who used it. Shows you built for a real user.

bullets.text: Analysed **40k orders** in SQL; recommended dropping one delivery slot, **adopted in 2 cities**.
bullets.note: A recommendation and its adoption, not just "analysed data".
Only what you can be asked about tomorrow. No skill bars.

bullets.text: B.Tech Computer Science, 2027 · CGPA 8.6 / 10 · Databases, Human-computer interaction
bullets.note: Add GPA only if it is strong. One line of coursework, at most.
